# ADR-3028: A03: LDAP filter concat for directory lookup 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

LDAP injection alters filter logic.

## Decision

Identity code MUST NOT build an LDAP filter concat for directory lookup 4 (A03-4).

## Consequences

Encode filter values with directory-safe APIs.
